# ONEUL

> ONEUL Inc. (주식회사 오엔이유엘) is a Korean software company building digital products that help people live each day more intentionally. The name ONEUL comes from the Korean word "오늘", meaning "today". Brand message: "Life ON, ONEUL".

ONEUL builds small, focused products rather than large platforms. Its three working principles are Respect (treat each other as equal colleagues regardless of role or seniority), Execution (show what is good for users by building it, not by talking about it), and Integrity (do what is right by its philosophy, not what is easy).

## Products

### MyDay

MyDay (마이데이) is an iOS daily planning app by ONEUL, designed around a daily cycle of morning planning, daytime focus, and evening reflection. Unlike typical todo apps that accumulate future tasks, MyDay focuses on a single day: users gather today's tasks from calendars, reminders, or direct input, then mark the most important ones as "Must Do" to clarify the day's priorities. Tagline: "Awake & Aware".

- Official website: https://myday.now
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Productivity / daily planning

## Pages

The site is available in Korean (ko), English (en), Japanese (ja), Simplified Chinese (zh) and Traditional Chinese (zh-tw). Every company page lives under a locale prefix: /ko, /en, /ja, /zh, /zh-tw. The language is chosen automatically from the visitor's time zone (Korea → ko, Japan → ja, mainland China → zh, Taiwan/Hong Kong/Macau → zh-tw, elsewhere → en) and can be switched in the header.

- Entry (choose company site or product site): /
- Home: /{locale}/main (e.g. /en/main)
- About ONEUL: /{locale}/about
- Products: /{locale}/products
- MyDay: /{locale}/products/myday
